description: Election Commission - Mr. A. M. Amsa of the Addalachchenai Pradeshiya Sabha Vacated his Office of that P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of a local authority (Addalachchenai Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority membership as specified in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
